articles.title: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Days After Board Ruled Out His Return
articles.description: The board said senior U.S. officials' input left it confident Huang's return poses no national security risk. Shares jumped 26% premarket.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Crypto Rebounds after NVDA Drives Friday Selloff
articles.description: The Nasdaq dropped 10% last week. Bitcoin lost 10% in a single day on Friday amidst cascading selloffs, though a relief rally is underway.

articles.title: Strategy Buys $30M in Bitcoin, Moves $1B From USD Reserve to Cash Pot
articles.description: Michael Saylor's firm raised its preferred stock buyback program to $4 billion after repurchasing another $212 million of STRC last week.

articles.title: Czech Authorities Charge 15 Over $12M Unlicensed Crypto Casino
articles.description: Investigators say "decentralized" casino BETFIN was run centrally, inflated its player numbers with bots and made $12 million illegally.

articles.title: Solana Meme Coin for Fiona the Hippo Raises $100K for Cincinnati Zoo Charity
articles.description: A meme coin honoring the Cincinnati Zoo's late pygmy hippo has sent its creator rewards to the zoo's nonprofit.

articles.title: Bitcoin Rebounds to $61K After Weekend Plunge to Two-Year Low
articles.description: Bitcoin swung by more than $6,000 over the weekend as tech stocks slid and spot ETFs logged their biggest daily outflow since June.

articles.title: Google's Quantum Chip Beats Classical Limits in 'Impossible' Game
articles.description: Google’s Willow quantum processor beat the classical ceiling in a four-qubit coordination game, revealing a promising hardware test rather than commercial quantum computing.

articles.title: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
articles.description: The anonymous leaker, Cyberleek, released a 209 GB Xbox build but is withholding the executable that could enable a PC port until its CYBERLEEK token hits $15 million.

articles.title: Fraudsters Used Fake Crypto Exchanges to Steal $37 Million, SEC Alleges
articles.description: The agency says eight Colorado-registered entities, likely run from overseas, posed as legitimate advisers and crypto platforms—even faking SEC certificates and filings—to defraud U.S. investors of more than $37 million.

articles.title: Signal Calls OS-Level AI an 'Existential Threat' and Blocks Screenshots to Fight It
articles.description: The encrypted-messaging app will restrict screenshots on iOS 27 and auto-enable screen security on Android when it detects an AI assistant reading a chat.

articles.title: Is the AI Bubble Finally Popping? Nvidia Crashes 48% as Wall Street Experts Sound the Alarm
articles.description: Tech stocks are buckling after Anthropic’s historic IPO and Nvidia’s leadership crisis, while Bitcoin has slipped below $60,000. Experts disagree on whether AI faces a correction or a dot-com-style bust.

articles.title: Claude Claims Historic Math Breakthrough One Day After Anthropic IPO
articles.description: Levent Alpöge claims Claude helped prove a 167-year-old math conjecture, but independent checks remain pending, and the release just after Anthropic’s IPO has prompted questions about its unusual publication timing.

articles.title: Nvidia Shares Sink to 52-Week Low After Report SEC Is Probing Accounting
articles.description: Nvidia shares fell about 13% to a 52-week low after reports that SEC enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues, adding to pressure on the chipmaker after Jensen Huang’s resignation.

articles.title: SBF’s 'The Altruists' Plot Twist: FTX’s Anthropic Shares Would Be Worth $43 Billion
articles.description: Anthropic’s IPO made FTX’s liquidated AI bet a $43 billion what-if, just as Netflix premiered its Sam Bankman-Fried drama.

articles.title: Cathie Wood Bets $91M on Anthropic IPO While Paring Crypto Exposure
articles.description: The firm bought 934,968 Anthropic shares across six ETFs on the Claude maker’s Nasdaq debut while trimming a combined $4.1 million from its Ethereum and Solana staking ETFs.

articles.title: Google Gives Gemini Control of Mac Apps, But Its New AI Agent Comes With Risks
articles.description: Gemini's new Mac computer-use feature navigates apps, files, and websites in a separate window, but Google's own documentation warns about prompt injection.

articles.title: Wrapped Monero Token Collapses 99% After $13 Million Hack Blamed on Web Host
articles.description: Wagyu’s XMR1 token fell more than 99% after an attacker moved 5.2 million tokens out of its deployer account and sold a fraction of them for $13.5 million.

articles.title: Bitcoin Breaks Below $60K as Crypto Fear Index Hits Worst Level Since February
articles.description: Bitcoin broke below $60,000 Friday as crypto sentiment collapsed and AI-linked stocks sank after Anthropic’s IPO.

articles.title: Senate Passes Bill Banning Prediction Market Bets on War, Terrorism and Death
articles.description: Sen. Adam Schiff's DEATH BETS Act would bar U.S.-regulated exchanges from listing contracts tied to war, assassinations or deaths.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Anthropic IPO Pops, Sinks Markets
articles.description: A (brief) win for Anthropic's ANT stock on IPO day meant a loss for just about every other major asset class.

articles.title: MoonPay Applies for National Trust Bank Charter to Grow Custody and Stablecoin Business
articles.description: The crypto payments firm joins a rush of crypto companies seeking federal trust charters, which face growing political scrutiny.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Shed $582M in a Day as BTC Drops Below $62K
articles.description: Thursday's ETF outflow was the funds' biggest in three weeks, as rising Treasury yields and Fed rate hike bets weigh on crypto.

articles.title: Coinbase Targets In-House Prediction Markets by First Half of 2027: Report
articles.description: The exchange offers event contracts through Kalshi, but running its own would give it more control and a bigger share of trading revenue.

articles.title: CryptoUK Urges FCA Not to Treat DeFi Devs as Regulated by Default
articles.description: The UK crypto trade group broadly backed the regulator's proposed perimeter guidance, but warned that parts of it go further than the law.

articles.title: Citi Says Customers Are Responsible When AI Banking Agents Go Rogue—Even After a Hack
articles.description: Citibank’s updated terms put customers on the hook for outside AI agents, including leaked logins.

articles.title: Nvidia, AMD, Micron Sink as Anthropic Closes 17% Above IPO Price
articles.description: Anthropic shares opened 34% above their $83 IPO price before giving up much of the gain, while Nvidia, AMD and other AI stocks slid across Wall Street.

articles.title: Meet SHRINCS: Bitcoin's Emerging Frontrunner for a Post-Quantum Signature
articles.description: A new post-quantum signature proposal aims to secure Bitcoin’s future, but balancing user safety and efficiency comes with hurdles.

articles.title: Hackers Leak Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan Customer Data
articles.description: A ransomware group breached third-party vendors, not the companies’ own systems. Visa said no card data was affected while Mastercard cited a limited cardholder subset.

articles.title: Bitcoin Enters Death Cross as Anthropic IPO Fails to Lift Wall Street
articles.description: Anthropic shares surged on their Nasdaq debut, but stocks slid and Bitcoin fell lower. Its daily chart shows deeply oversold momentum, a strong downtrend, and fragile support.

articles.title: Protesters Arrested Outside Nasdaq as Activists Oppose Anthropic IPO Over AI Bubble Risks
articles.description: At least four people were arrested outside Nasdaq during Anthropic’s historic IPO, as protesters warned that AI valuations could leave retirement savers exposed to a potential market crash and broader economic losses.

articles.title: What Are Perpetual Futures? How Crypto's Most Popular Derivative Works
articles.description: Perpetual futures let traders bet on prices with leverage and no expiry date. Here's how they work, and why they dominate crypto trading.

articles.title: Anthropic Stock Opens 33% Above IPO Price as AI Stocks Rally
articles.description: The Claude maker's shares could debut at $110, pushing its valuation toward $2 trillion as enthusiasm for its historic IPO lifts the broader technology sector.

articles.title: Anthropic Tops SpaceX's Initial IPO With $81 Billion Deal: Where the Money Went
articles.description: The Claude maker beat SpaceX's original share sale, though not its expanded final IPO. Here's who got the money and why the computing bill could be even bigger.

articles.title: Gen Z Embraces Crypto While Most Americans Call It a 'Side Quest'
articles.description: A SoFi and YouGov survey found that 21% of Gen Z adults own crypto, more than hold employer retirement plans, even as only 13% of all Americans own it and most remain skeptical.

articles.title: Quantum Upgrade Could Be 'Particularly Challenging' for Blockchains: IOSCO
articles.description: The global securities watchdog said markets shouldn't wait for quantum computers to arrive, flagging bulkier signatures and harder upgrades.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Google’s Newest AI Model Tops Benchmarks Ahead of Anthropic IPO
articles.description: Anthropic bulls seem to be shrugging off the news, as ANT pops 25% over IPO price on Hyperliquid pre-debut.
